scripts.build: node scripts/build.mjs --clean && pnpm generate && tsc && node scripts/build.mjs
scripts.test: pnpm build && tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json && node scripts/test.mjs
scripts.test:popup-mask: pnpm build && LUNA_SCREENSHOT_DIR=${LUNA_SCREENSHOT_DIR:-/tmp/luna-popup-mask} bash scripts/test-shell.sh "$PWD/tests/popup-mask-shell.js" && python3 tests/check-popup-mask.py ${LUNA_SCREENSHOT_DIR:-/tmp/luna-popup-mask}
scripts.test:overview-backdrop: pnpm build && bash scripts/test-shell.sh "$PWD/tests/overview-backdrop-shell.js" && python3 tests/overview-backdrop-pixels.py
scripts.test:live-backdrop: pnpm build && bash scripts/test-shell.sh "$PWD/tests/live-backdrop-shell.js" && python3 tests/live-backdrop-pixels.py
